# Annie

## Study background

M.Sc. Computer Engineering 5th Semester from November 2024

## Interests

Travelling, Cooking

## Fun fact

I was born in Dubai, UAE and my birth certificate is in Arabic.

## What I think about AI in software engineering today

AI makes software development faster by helping developers write code, debug errors, and automate repetitive tasks.

## Where software engineering will be in 5–10 years

Almost Dead, which is scary because I believe the world can be taken over by AI (Accidently or not)

## My hot take on AI

AI can generate code in seconds, but in the end to check if that code is correct and valid, is what makes someone a real software engineer.

# Avishkar

## Study background
M.Sc. Computer Engineering 3nd Semester from October 2026

## Interests
Stock Market Investing, Playing 70's-80's band songs on guitar

## Fun fact
I have personal record of 3000 jump ropes in under 45 minutes.

## What I think about AI in software engineering today
AI now acts as a great filter for REAL engineers who have a strong hold on concepts like system design, security, scaling etc. 


## Where software engineering will be in 5–10 years
Engineers will shift from writing code to designing systems and orchestrating AI agents. Understanding architecture and making good decisions will matter more than writing code.

## My hot take on AI
I don't think AI would scale a lot, atleast not in the short-medium term future. 
The projected energy demands for AI is way more than what experts think we can produce.

results.text: # SG-19: Theme persistence (version 1) Status: DEPRECATED – replaced by SG-21 Category: Theming The theme choice of the user is remembered between visits. - Store the choice in `localStorage` under the key `theme`. - The stored value is either `light` or `dark`. - Read the value when the page loads and apply it before the first paint.
# SG-57: Print styles Status: ACTIVE Category: Structure Print styles are optional. - If provided, hide the theme toggle when printing. - Print always in day mode colors.

# SG-21: Theme persistence (version 2) Status: ACTIVE (version 2) Category: Theming The theme choice of the user is remembered between visits. - The choice MUST be stored in `localStorage` under the key `upb-theme`. The old key was too generic and collided with other local files. - The stored value is either `light` or `dark`. - On page load, read the stored value. If there is none, follow the operating system preference. - Apply the theme as early as possible to avoid a flash of the wrong theme.

# SG-22: Theme toggle control Status: ACTIVE Category: Theming - The toggle MUST be a `<button>` element with the id `theme-toggle`. - It MUST have an `aria-label` describing the action, for example `aria-label="Switch to night mode"`. Update the label when the theme changes. - It SHOULD show a sun symbol in night mode and a moon symbol in day mode. - It SHOULD be placed in the top right corner of the header. - Don't use a checkbox for the toggle.

# SG-20: Theme switching mechanics Status: ACTIVE Category: Theming The theme is controlled by one attribute on the root element. - The `<html>` element MUST carry the attribute `data-theme` with the value `light` or `dark`. - JavaScript switches the theme by changing this attribute, not by toggling classes on the body. - The CSS MUST define the colors for each theme with attribute selectors, for example `[data-theme="light"] { ... }` and `[data-theme="dark"] { ... }`. - Components use CSS custom properties (for example `var(--bg)`), so they don't need theme-specific rules.

results.text: # SG-02: Page metadata Status: ACTIVE (version 2) Category: Structure Every team website MUST set the following metadata in the document head. ## Title The page title MUST have the format: Team <group name> | Agentic SE Lab Example: `Team Null Pointers | Agentic SE Lab`. Use a vertical bar, not a dash. The group name in the title MUST match the group name shown in the page header. ## Language The root `<html>` element MUST declare English as the page language: `lang="en"`. Even if some content is written in German, the declared language stays English. ## Other metadata - The character set MUST be UTF-8. - A `<meta name="viewport">` tag MUST be present, see the responsive documents. - A `<meta name="description">` SHOULD contain one sentence about the team.

# SG-52: Typography scale Status: ACTIVE Category: Typography All font sizes MUST be given in `rem`. Pixel font sizes are not allowed, because they ignore the user's browser settings. | Element | Size | |---|---| | body | 1rem | | h1 | 2.5rem | | h2 | 1.75rem | | h3 | 1.25rem | | hot take badge | 0.9rem | | footer | 0.8rem | Line height of body text: 1.6.
